records.text: Donald Trump no longer represents the populist movement and has become aligned with the Never Trump movement.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Obviously, the crowd, the populist movement is not being represented by Trump anymore. This is everyone who was a part of the Never Trump movement is now supporting Trump. I say Trump became Never Trump.

verification.notes: The transcript is a political classification of Donald Trump and the populist and Never Trump movements. Those labels and the threshold for alignment are subjective, so the proposition is not conclusively verifiable.
